prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait eye atlas
Input image: Image 1 is the ONLY reference and edit target: the exact 2x2 grid of repeated upper portrait halves. Preserve its grid layout and every cell boundary.
Primary request: Edit only the eyes and brows in this supplied atlas to express warm, happy, smiling eyes. The four row-major cells are open, half-closed, closed, repeated open. Keep each cell as the same face and camera crop; return the complete atlas with no labels or added margins.
Style/medium: subdued late-1990s fantasy pixel-art portrait, crisp native-grid pixels and restrained pixel clusters; no smooth vector shapes or painterly blur.
Expression: clearly warm and gently happy, with subtle cheek and lower-lid lift and relaxed brows. Do not use startled, alarmed, high-arched brows. Make the happy expression visibly distinct from neutral through softly lifted outer cheek/lid contour and friendly, relaxed brow shape, while retaining the face identity.
Eye anatomy: keep both eyes aligned, same spacing, gaze direction, pupil location, gray-violet iris width, and stationary glints across phases. In half-closed and closed phases, lids cover the eye vertically only; never shift, shrink, round, or move irises/glints. Closed phase conceals iris and sclera fully. Repeated-open cell matches first open cell. Keep stationary orbital creases and consistent relaxed brows in all four cells.
Color palette: preserve the reference's subdued warm tan/brown skin, olive-brown eye shadows, gray-violet irises, soft brown details, and softly blended pixel-art contrast. No orange skin, bright white flashes, heavy near-black brows, or new colors outside the reference palette.
Constraints: alter only eye/brow expression inside the existing eye/brow feature areas; preserve face width, nose, cheeks, hair, neck, background, pixel placement, crop, and 2x2 atlas structure. No text, symbols, decorations, or watermark.
